story.heading: 20+ years at the heart of Vietnam's lifting industry
paragraphs: United Mekong Holding Company is a leading supplier of rigging, towing, and mooring equipment in Vietnam. It was founded in 2008 in Vung Tau City — Vietnam's oil & gas capital — to serve the rigorous demands of offshore installations, onshore projects, and port operations. Today we run our own 3500 S.Q.M rigging workshop, a Dragon Sling Division (synthetic sling manufacturing) alongside our specialist subsidiary ITIS (testing and inspection services).

We are the authorised distributor of Vanbeest B.V - Netherland with wellknown Brand Named Green Pin and also we are slole distributor for ABLE Forge in Vietnam, holding stock in Vung Tau for immediate supply. Every assembly we produce is proof-tested in-house and delivered with traceable certificates.

Our customers — from Tanker, FPSO operators and rig contractors to shipyards and port terminals, onshore industrial contractors — share one requirement: zero tolerance for unverified lifting gear. That is the standard we hold ourselves to on every order.

items.title: Quality
items.desc: Every product we supply meets industrial and world standards, is certified, and is insured by PVI Insurance Company. No shortcuts, no grey-market stock.

items.title: Reliability
items.desc: Genuine hardware from authorised brands — Green Pin, ABLE — with full traceability from mill to deck.

items.title: Competitive price
items.desc: Direct authorised distributor pricing with stock held in Vung Tau for immediate off-the-shelf supply.

items.title: Best delivery time
items.desc: Technical reply within one business day. Assemblies proof-tested and dispatched on schedule.
